inlines.v: 'ASS, noun [Latin asinus; Gr. an ear.] 1. A quadruped of the equine genus. This animal has long slouching ears, a short mane, and a tail covered with long hairs at the end. He is usually of an ash color, with a black bar across the shoulders. The tame or domestic ass is patient to stupidity, and carries a heavy burden. He is slow, but very sure footed, and for this reason very useful on rough steep hills. 2. A dull, heavy, stupid fellow; a dolt.
